fact: Sample is PE32 i386 Windows GUI CLR/.NET assembly; CLR metadata is readable.
ClickEngine worker branches on ClickConfig.FreeMouseMode; true uses background message paths, false physical cursor/SendInput paths.
SendBackgroundClick resolves WindowFromPoint, optionally RealChildWindowFromPoint, converts coordinates with ScreenToClient, then posts mouse messages.
Background sequence is WM_MOUSEMOVE then button DOWN, optional hold, then button UP.
PerformClickDirectToWindow accepts HWND + client point, retargets child HWND and posts mouse messages without moving OS cursor.
SendPhysicalClick builds INPUT/MOUSEINPUT and calls SendInput for DOWN/UP.
ActionExecutor.PerformClick has background PostMessage and physical SetCursorPos+SendInput branches.
FindWindowByTarget strips .exe, normalizes title, caches HWND about 1000ms, validates window/visibility/not-minimized and uses EnumWindows discovery.
ResolveActualPoint converts stored client-relative point to screen with ClientToScreen when RelativeToWindow is enabled.
Background paths use RealChildWindowFromPoint and recompute child-local coordinates.
MacroActionType has 13 actions from LeftClick(0) through RunScript(12).
Pixel conditions use GetDC/ReleaseDC + gdi32 GetPixel and tolerance matching.
KeyPress and TypeText use SendInput; TypeText uses Unicode keyboard flags.
DragDrop is physical: SetCursorPos(start), SendInput left-down, smooth cursor movement, SendInput left-up.
Overlay can toggle WS_EX_TRANSPARENT and uses MA_NOACTIVATE/HTTRANSPARENT logic; this is separate from target click injection.
UnfocusClickFilter manages click/focus behavior inside the tool UI; it is not the background target-click engine.
ClickEngine.Start creates a background worker thread; macro execution uses runner loops/sleeps.
MacroStorage serializes/deserializes JSON profiles/projects and embedded templates expose persisted schema.
EXE embeds three managed JSON templates: All Action, Piano Tile and Piano Tile opt 2.
Manifest declares per-monitor DPI awareness; Program tries SetProcessDpiAwareness and fallback SetProcessDPIAware.
Manifest requests asInvoker and uiAccess=false; sample does not request elevation.
Targets relying exclusively on Raw Input/DirectInput/device polling or rejecting synthetic messages may ignore PostMessage clicks.
